key.name: window-rules
key.description: Dictionary mapping window identifier to exclusion rule mode. Key format (composite static fingerprint): - 'app': matches all windows of this app (e.g. 'wechat') - 'app:dialog': matches child dialogs/transient windows of this app (e.g. 'wechat:dialog') - 'app:title=...': matches windows with specific title (e.g. 'wechat:title=Exit') Value modes: - 'disable-all': disable all decorations (no shadow, no corners) - 'disable-clip': disable rounded corners (retaining shadow) - 'disable-shadow': disable shadow (retaining rounded corners)

key.name: prefer-crisp-text
key.description: Skip rounded corners on fractional scale monitors (retaining shadow) to avoid text blur and resampling overhead.
